description: Source code implementing RPC transport for Trusty IPC in Android, including classes for handling transport over TIPC sockets, with methods for polling, reading, writing, and buffer management.

classes.name: RpcTransportTipcAndroid
classes.description: Handles RPC transport over TIPC sockets for Android, including polling, reading, writing, and buffer management.

classes.name: RpcTransportCtxTipcAndroid
classes.description: Factory for creating RpcTransport instances and managing context for TIPC-based RPC transport.

methods.name: pollRead
methods.description: Checks if data is available to read on the socket, handling various poll events.

methods.name: interruptableWriteFully
methods.description: Writes data fully to the socket, with support for interruption and ancillary file descriptors.

methods.name: interruptableReadFully
methods.description: Reads data fully from the socket, with support for interruption and buffer management.

methods.name: isWaiting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in a polling state.

methods.name: adjustStatus
methods.description: Adjusts error status, converting ENOTCONN to DEAD_OBJECT.

methods.name: fillReadBuffer
methods.description: Fills internal read buffer from the socket, handling buffer resizing and errors.
